findings.summary: Unknown cleanup blocks only supervisor-loop entries. close/start on the same object can launch again without proving that old cleanup became complete; successful new registration discards the old blocked marker.
findings.scope: static interleaving, not a demonstrated financial double writer or original CI cause

findings.summary: Workers/start-gate references are removed before all handle/process close operations complete. A later close error leaves cleanup false/blocked but no router-owned handle inventory for subsequent cleanup.
findings.scope: child exit was checked first, so this alone is not a claim of an active second financial writer

findings.summary: New retry loop does not recheck stop after acquiring mutex, unlike the existing dead-child respawn guard. A waiting monitor can create/release a fresh actor after close has requested stop.
findings.scope: static possible interleaving; no native testcase or SQL was executed
